lean.statement:
let g := fun (n : ℕ+) (h : ℕ) (i : Fin (h + 1))
    (p : {p : ℕ // Even p ∧ 4 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 2 ^ (64 * (h + 1))})
    (u : Fin (h - i.val + 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n.val))
    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ
      ((Fin p.val × (Σ j : Fin (h - i.val + 1),
        Fin ((2 ^ (74 * (h + 1))) ^ j.val))) → Fin n.val)) ↦
  let S : ℕ := ∑ j : Fin (h - i.val + 1), (2 ^ (74 * (h + 1))) ^ j.val
  let a : ℝ := 1 / ((p.val : ℝ) ^ 4 * (S : ℝ) ^ 2 *
    Real.sqrt ((h - i.val + 1 : ℕ) * Real.log (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (64 * (h + 1)) * S)))
  Real.sqrt n.val * a * ∑ c, ξ c * ∏ s, u s.2.1 (c s)
;
∀ (n : ℕ+) (h : ℕ) (i : Fin (h + 1))
    (x : Fin (h - i.val + 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n.val)),
    let P := {p : Fin (2 ^ (64 * (h + 1)) + 1) // Even p.val ∧ 4 ≤ p.val}
    let B := Fin (h + 1) × P
    let C := fun b : B ↦
      ((Fin b.2.val.val × (Σ j : Fin (h - b.1.val + 1),
        Fin ((2 ^ (74 * (h + 1))) ^ j.val))) → Fin n.val)
    let degree := fun p : P ↦
      (⟨p.val.val, p.property.1, p.property.2, Nat.le_of_lt_succ p.val.isLt⟩ :
        {p : ℕ // Even p ∧ 4 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 2 ^ (64 * (h + 1))})
    let S : ℕ := ∑ j : Fin (h - i.val + 1), (2 ^ (74 * (h + 1))) ^ j.val
    let a := fun p : P ↦ 1 / ((p.val.val : ℝ) ^ 4 * (S : ℝ) ^ 2 *
      Real.sqrt ((h - i.val + 1 : ℕ) * Real.log (2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ (64 * (h + 1)) * S)))
    let χ := fun r : ℝ ↦
      expNegInvGlue (r - 13 / 20) /
        (expNegInvGlue (r - 13 / 20) + expNegInvGlue (7 / 10 - r)) *
      (expNegInvGlue (1 - r) /
        (expNegInvGlue (1 - r) + expNegInvGlue (r - 19 / 20)))
    let c := ∏ j, χ (‖x j‖ / Real.sqrt n.val)
    let F := fun (u : Fin (h - i.val + 1) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n.val))
        (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Σ b : B, C b)) ↦ ∑ p : P,
      g n h i (degree p) u
        (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun c : C (i, p) ↦ ξ ⟨(i, p), c⟩))
    let H := fun ξ ↦ if ∃ j, x j = 0 then 0
      else c * F (fun j ↦ NormedSpace.normalize (x j)) ξ
    HasLaw H (gaussianReal 0 (((n.val : ℝ) * c ^ 2 * ∑ p : P, (a p) ^ 2).toNNReal))
      (stdGaussian (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Σ b : B, C b)))
approved_definition_context: ℕ+ denotes positive natural numbers; Fin m denotes natural values strictly below m; .val extracts the underlying value; Even is parity. A dependent sum Σ b, C b pairs a label with one of its indices.
EuclideanSpace ℝ J is finite real Euclidean space with index J, and WithLp.toLp 2 packages the same coordinate array without rescaling. Sums/products run over all elements of the finite index types.
expNegInvGlue t = exp(-1/t) if t>0 and 0 otherwise. NormedSpace.normalize z is the vector z multiplied by the inverse of its norm; it has norm one for z≠0 and equals zero at z=0.

stdGaussian is the real Euclidean Gaussian measure of mean zero and identity covariance. gaussianReal m v is the real Gaussian with mean m and variance v, with Dirac law when v=0. r.toNNReal equals max(r,0) encoded as a nonnegative real.

HasLaw H ν μ means almost-everywhere measurability under μ and pushforward H♯μ=ν. Parameters before the local definitions are deterministic; the random draw is only the vector under the displayed measure. Real.sqrt is the nonnegative square root and Real.log is the natural logarithm.
